title: 3 Mario Facts You Didn't Know 🤯 #shorts
description:
Bowser was supposed to be an ox. 🐂
1) Mario's mustache exists because the old pixels couldn't draw a mouth, and the cap because hair was too hard to animate.
2) In Super Mario Bros., the clouds and the bushes are the same drawing in a different color.
3) Miyamoto first drew Bowser as an ox, until Takashi Tezuka said it looked like a turtle.
Sources: Iwata Asks (Nintendo), Kotaku, Wikipedia
